title: Curvatures and Non-metricities in the Non-Relativistic Limit of Bosonic Supergravity
summary: We construct a metric-like formulation of the non-relativistic (NR) limit of bosonic supergravity at the Lagrangian level. This formulation is particularly useful for decomposing relativistic tensors, such as powers of the Riemann tensor, in a manifest covariant form with respect to infinitesimal diffeomorphisms. The construction is purely geometrical and is based on a torsionless connection, mimicking the construction of the relativistic theory.
